en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a gently rising cobblestone street flanked by 3–4 storey masonry houses with shops at ground level. At the far end stands a medieval-looking city gate or tower with a high, steep roof and a large archway through which a horse‑drawn vehicle is passing. Several people and children are visible in the street. German shop signs are painted on the façades along the right and left sides of the street.
